newsitem.title: CANADA: Placer Dome bids for Highlands Gold.
newsitem.headline: Placer Dome bids for Highlands Gold.

text.p: Placer Dome Inc said on Wednesday it was launching a takeover bid to buy Highlands Gold Ltd, a Papua New Guinea company which owns 25 percent of the Porgera joint venture.

Placer also said it was bidding for the 24.6 percent publicly owned interest in its subsidiary, Placer Pacific Ltd. The two bids have a total value of about US$600 million, Placer said in a statement.

The bid for Highlands is a cash offer of A$0.75 per share. Placer, which already owns 33 percent of Highlands Gold, said the offer is a 36 percent premium to the price of Highlands shares on November 26.
Placer said it is offering one Placer Dome share for every 15 Placer Pacific shares, which is a premium of almost 50 percent.

"This is about growth for Placer Dome shareholders and a golden opportunity for the shareholders of Highlands Gold and minority shareholders of Placer Pacific," John Willson, Placer's chief executive, said in a statement.
"We have great confidence in the Asia Pacific region. Placer Dome is consolidating ts presence to compete more effectively."
